arrow.export.intro: Export a primitive to a Parquet file, then import it back.
arrow.export.cli:
$ strata kv put greeting hello
$ strata command run --command-json '{"format":"parquet","path":"/tmp/exports/kv.parquet","primitive":"kv","type":"arrow_export"}'  # One file per primitive; Parquet by default.
$ strata kv delete greeting
$ strata arrow import /tmp/exports/kv.parquet --target kv
$ strata kv get greeting

arrow.import.intro: Import a primitive's rows from a Parquet file written by export.
arrow.import.cli:
$ strata kv put greeting hello
$ strata command run --command-json '{"format":"parquet","path":"/tmp/exports/kv.parquet","primitive":"kv","type":"arrow_export"}'
$ strata kv delete greeting
$ strata arrow import /tmp/exports/kv.parquet --target kv  # Rows are keyed by their source column; kv restores greeting=hello.
$ strata kv get greeting

branch.create.cli:
$ strata branch create feature
$ strata branch list

branch.delete.cli:
$ strata branch create temp
$ strata branch delete temp
$ strata branch list

branch.diff.intro: Compare a fork against the branch it came from, across primitives.
branch.diff.cli:
$ strata vector collection create notes 2 --metric cosine
$ strata kv put config base
$ strata branch fork default experiment
$ strata command run --command-json '{"branch":"experiment","key":"Y29uZmln","type":"kv_put","value":"dHVuZWQ="}'  # diverge the key-value entry on the fork
$ strata command run --command-json '{"branch":"experiment","collection":"notes","key":"n1","type":"vector_upsert","vector":[0.1,0.2]}'  # add a vector on the fork
$ strata branch diff default experiment  # reports the key-value change and the new vector, grouped by capability

branch.fork.intro: Fork a branch from another branch's head.
branch.fork.cli:
$ strata branch fork default experiment
$ strata branch list

branch.fork_at_timestamp.intro: Fork a branch at an earlier commit timestamp - time-travel into a branch.
branch.fork_at_timestamp.cli:
$ strata kv put greeting original  # The receipt carries this commit's timestamp (microseconds).
$ strata kv put greeting updated
$ strata command run --command-json '{"branch":"snapshot","source":"default","timestamp":3,"type":"branch_fork_at_timestamp"}'  # snapshot forks default's history as of that instant.
$ strata command run --command-json '{"branch":"snapshot","key":"Z3JlZXRpbmc=","type":"kv_get"}'

branch.fork_at_version.intro: Fork a branch at an earlier commit version - a snapshot of history.
branch.fork_at_version.cli:
$ strata kv put greeting original  # The receipt carries this commit's version.
$ strata kv put greeting updated
$ strata command run --command-json '{"branch":"snapshot","source":"default","type":"branch_fork_at_version","version":3}'  # snapshot forks default's history at that version.
$ strata command run --command-json '{"branch":"snapshot","key":"Z3JlZXRpbmc=","type":"kv_get"}'

branch.get.cli:
$ strata branch create feature
$ strata branch get feature

branch.list.cli:
$ strata branch create feature
$ strata branch list

branch.merge.intro: Promote a fork's change back into the branch it came from.
branch.merge.cli:
$ strata kv put config base
$ strata branch fork default experiment
$ strata command run --command-json '{"branch":"experiment","key":"Y29uZmln","type":"kv_put","value":"dHVuZWQ="}'  # change on the fork
$ strata branch merge experiment default --strategy strict  # applies the fork's change onto default

branch.preview.intro: Preview promoting a fork into the branch it came from.
branch.preview.cli:
$ strata kv put config base
$ strata branch fork default experiment
$ strata command run --command-json '{"branch":"experiment","key":"Y29uZmln","type":"kv_put","value":"dHVuZWQ="}'  # change on the fork
$ strata branch preview experiment default --strategy strict  # a clean preview - no conflicting changes on default

graph.apply_delete_policy.intro: Cascade-delete graph facts bound to an entity.
graph.apply_delete_policy.cli:
$ strata graph create kb
$ strata command run --command-json '{"binding":{"target":{"key":"user:1","primitive":"kv","space":"default"}},"graph":"kb","node_id":"ada","type":"graph_add_node"}'
$ strata command run --command-json '{"policy":"cascade","target":{"key":"user:1","primitive":"kv","space":"default"},"type":"graph_apply_delete_policy"}'  # cascade removes the bound node and its incident edges.
$ strata graph get-node kb ada

graph.batch_write.intro: Apply several node and edge mutations in one atomic commit.
graph.batch_write.cli:
$ strata graph create g
$ strata command run --command-json '{"graph":"g","operations":[{"data":{"object_type":"person"},"node_id":"a","type":"upsert_node"},{"data":{"object_type":"person"},"node_id":"b","type":"upsert_node"},{"data":{},"dst":"b","edge_type":"knows","src":"a","type":"upsert_edge"}],"type":"graph_batch_write"}'  # All operations land in one engine commit, or none do.
$ strata graph meta g

graph.bindings.intro: List graph nodes bound to a product entity.
graph.bindings.cli:
$ strata graph create kb
$ strata command run --command-json '{"binding":{"target":{"key":"user:1","primitive":"kv","space":"default"}},"graph":"kb","node_id":"ada","type":"graph_add_node"}'  # Bind the node to a KV entity so retrieval can cross primitives.
$ strata command run --command-json '{"target":{"key":"user:1","primitive":"kv","space":"default"},"type":"graph_bindings_for_entity"}'

graph.bulk_insert.intro: Insert many nodes and edges in one commit.
graph.bulk_insert.cli:
$ strata graph create g
$ strata command run --command-json '{"edges":[{"dst":"b","edge_type":"knows","src":"a"}],"graph":"g","nodes":[{"node_id":"a","object_type":"person"},{"node_id":"b","object_type":"person"}],"type":"graph_bulk_insert"}'
$ strata graph meta g
